query:
SELECT 
  id, section, isComplete, 
  summary IS NOT NULL as hasSummary,
  JSON_LENGTH(messages) as messageCount,
  createdAt, updatedAt
FROM chat_sessions
WHERE clientId = 810001
ORDER BY createdAt;
